name: Demon Lover

name: Twelve Witches
review: One witch charms people with her lyre into burning themselves alive, while another is vegetarian. I'm not saying we shouldn't hold the witches all in dread, but maybe some more than others? I wonder if this at some point was about a group of real people.
lyric: Rowan tree, red thread; hold the witches all in dread

name: Sir James the Rose
review: Steeleye Span may be the perfect band for me because I love songs with a narrative but never vibed with King Gizz.
lyric: Where shall I go for to hide me? For I have killed a gallant squire, and they're seeking for to slay me

name: I am a Scientist
review: I previously had two Future Islands songs I liked: this song and Give me the Ghost Back. Now I only have one because I learned this is a Guided by Voices song; my bad.
lyric: But I'm losing sight of the clues for which I search and choose to abuse to just unlock my mind.
